requests.description: Creates a group within the specified identity store.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSIdentityStore.CreateGroup
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SSO_IDENTITY_STORE_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
